synthesis: Root cause (confirmed by two independent blind prep passes + direct source verification): ClarityScoutMapController::heatmapOrders() unconditionally runs BOTH the 'direct' and 'staging' order layers through clipRowsToAssignedZones(), which returns [] whenever the authenticated user has zero assigned zones (User->zones() empty). A Scout kit reached via the admin Force-Login impersonation flow (ClarityScoutForceLoginController) — as in the reported demo — has no assigned zone, so both order layers render blank. Live Hit Density 'works' because heatmapHits() only clips when the client explicitly sends zone_ids (opt-in), degrading to org-wide; Teammate Activity 'works' because Force-Login hard-codes teammate_overlay_enabled=true. This also proves the repro surface is the DRIVER Scout PWA via Force-Login, NOT the Bird's Eye org-map SPA (where Teammate Activity is hidden in adminMode). The adminMode/HTML-not-JSON fetch-leak hypothesis (DEV-2116/2184) was investigated and RULED OUT: the driver heatmap endpoints live in routes/api.php under auth:sanctum + ClarityScoutMiddleware, are never reachable by the web.php SPA catch-all, and return a normal 200 JSON empty FeatureCollection. CONFLICT: the in-app HelpPanel copy (HelpPanel.vue:158 and :346), authored 2026-07-01 (#249) — one day AFTER the code that clips both layers (2026-06-30, #242) — documents 'Direct Orders and Live Hit Density show across the whole organization' while 'Staging Orders is clipped to your zone(s)'. So the current documented product intent is Direct=org-wide, Staging=zone-clipped; the code clips both. Fixing Direct to org-wide matches the documented intent and the ticket's expected behavior. Whether Staging should ALSO render for zone-less drivers is a genuine product decision (its zone gate is a deliberate AC#4 'push users to configure zones' nudge).

scope.summary: Give Direct Orders a graceful zero-zone fallback: clipped to assigned zone(s) when the driver has >=1 zone, org-wide (run-area/bbox) when they have none. Staging Orders unchanged.

proposed_changes.change: In heatmapOrders(), make the Direct layer's zone clip conditional: when the user has >=1 assigned zone, clip Direct to zones (unchanged); when the user has ZERO assigned zones, skip the clip for Direct (org-wide/run-area). Staging is ALWAYS clipped (unchanged). Update the heatmapOrders (:417-419) and clipRowsToAssignedZones (:624-628) docblocks to describe the Direct zero-zone fallback.
proposed_changes.reason: Root-cause fix restoring Direct to org-wide, matching documented intent (HelpPanel.vue:158,:346) and the ticket's expected behavior.

proposed_changes.change: Invert the tests that currently pin Direct-is-zone-clipped (test_heatmap_orders_direct_is_empty_without_assigned_zones / test_heatmap_orders_direct_clips_to_assigned_zones) to assert Direct renders regardless of assigned zones; fix the stale comment at ~:1104 ('Direct ignores zones either way') and adjust the direct+staging union test's fixture to the corrected behavior. Keep the Staging zone-clip tests unchanged (unless the gate decision relaxes Staging).
proposed_changes.reason: Existing tests pin the contested behavior; they must move in lockstep with the fix or CI fails and intent gets re-litigated silently.

Staging stays 'clipped to your zone(s)'. Then npm run build and commit rebuilt public/build assets.

questions.q: Direct Orders: confirm the fix is to make Direct render org-wide (stop clipping it to assigned zones), matching HelpPanel.vue and the ticket. Evidence strongly supports yes — the help copy (authored one day after the clip code) says Direct is org-wide.
questions.answer: Direct Orders: clip to the driver's assigned zone(s) when they have >=1 zone; when they have ZERO zones, do NOT clip (show org-wide/run-area). This graceful fallback only changes the zero-zone case and fixes the impersonated-demo repro.

questions.q: Staging Orders: should it ALSO render org-wide for drivers with no assigned zones, or intentionally stay zone-clipped (empty until zones are configured — the deliberate AC#4 nudge, per HelpPanel copy)? The ticket expects both layers to render, but the reporter may not know Staging is zone-gated by design.
questions.answer: Staging Orders: leave exactly as-is (zone-clipped; empty when no zones). No change.

notes: Two independent blind prep passes converged on the identical root cause with file:line grounding; adminMode fetch-leak hypothesis independently ruled out by both.

Zones (zone_user pivot) are a newer feature (migrations 2026-05-12); many real Scout drivers may have no assigned zone, so this bug (as coded) silently blanks Direct+Staging Orders for a large fraction of users — consistent with High severity.
clipRowsToAssignedZones is private to ClarityScoutMapController (not shared via ScoutMapHelpers); BirdsEyeController has its own run-area clip and is unaffected.

Stale test comment at ClarityScoutMapControllerTest.php:~1104 ('Direct ignores zones either way') contradicts the passing test at ~:1154 that asserts Direct IS clipped — a signal the #242/#195 Direct-clip may be unreconciled against its own intent.
Dalton (2026-08-03) approved updating HelpPanel.vue copy to match the conditional Direct behavior — adds a Vue edit + npm run build + committed public/build assets to this PR.
